seo.title: FAQs, Pet Waste Removal & Collection in Aberdare & RCT
seo.description: Answers on pricing, frequency, what happens to the waste, areas covered, and how booking works for pet waste garden clean-ups across Rhondda Cynon Taf.

hero.lead: Everything customers usually ask before their first visit. Can't find your answer? Message us and we'll reply the same day.

items.q: How much does pet waste removal cost?
items.text: From £10 per clean for a small garden with one pet on a weekly round, rising with garden size, number of pets and frequency. See our pricing page for the full breakdown.
items.html: From £10 per clean for a small garden with one pet on a weekly round, rising with garden size, number of pets and frequency. See our pricing page for the full breakdown.

items.q: Why are first cleans priced separately?
items.text: If there's a build-up, long grass, decking, stones, slate or artificial grass, the first visit takes considerably longer. First cleans usually start from £20 depending on what's there.
No. We confirm your price upfront before the first visit and tell you in advance of any change.

items.q: How often should I have my garden cleared?
items.text: Weekly is most popular and keeps gardens consistently tidy and low-odour. Fortnightly suits smaller single-pet gardens, though each visit takes longer.

items.q: Is dog poo bad for my lawn?
items.text: Left to sit, it can scorch grass and leave patchy yellowed areas, and it's a common source of bacteria and parasites in gardens where children or other pets play. Regular removal is the simplest fix.

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.text: No, as long as we can access the garden. Just tell us how to get in (side gate code, etc.) when you book.

items.q: Do you still clean in winter?
items.text: Yes. We clean and collect all year round, rain or shine, waste doesn't stop in bad weather.

items.q: Do you sanitise as well as clear?
items.text: Yes. Every clean includes treating the area with pet-friendly sanitiser to help remove germs and reduce infection risk.

items.q: What if I already bag my own waste?
items.text: That's our collection service, you bag it, we take it away. From £10.
items.html: That's our collection service, you bag it, we take it away. From £10.

items.text: Yes, as an add-on to a scheduled visit, at £3 per bag collected alongside your garden clean.
items.html: Yes, as an add-on to a scheduled visit, at £3 per bag collected alongside your garden clean.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.text: Message us or use the quote form with your postcode, garden size and number of pets. A photo helps us price fairly. We come back the same day.
items.html: Message us or use the quote form with your postcode, garden size and number of pets. A photo helps us price fairly. We come back the same day.

items.q: Do I have to sign a contract?
items.text: No. No contracts, cancel any time.

items.q: Do you clean patios, decking and artificial grass too?
items.text: Yes, they're cleared and treated as part of your clean, not charged separately. Every visit includes treating the area with our pet-safe deodorising and sanitising spray.

items.q: Why does my artificial grass still smell after I hose it?
items.text: Because urine soaks past the surface into the backing, and rinsing only dilutes what's on top. Regular clearing and sanitising keeps it from building up. If it's been left a long time and the smell has reached the infill or sub-base, regular treatment will help but may not fully fix it, at that point you may need a specialist restoration or infill replacement, which isn't something we offer.

items.q: What do you use on artificial grass?
items.text: Our pet-safe deodorising and sanitising spray, which is safe for pets, children and artificial surfaces once dry.
Yes, fully insured. We're also DBS checked.

items.q: Are your products safe for pets and children?
items.text: Yes, pet-safe products and biodegradable bags throughout.
